name: Multifunctional 5-Blade Vegetable Cutter & Grater | Stainless Steel Kitchen Tool
description:
The Multifunctional 5-Blade Vegetable Cutter & Grater makes meal prep quick, safe, and efficient. With interchangeable stainless steel blades, this tool lets you slice, shred, grate, and peel vegetables or fruits in seconds. Compact, durable, and easy to clean, it’s a must-have for every modern kitchen. Enjoy effortless cooking and neatly prepared meals with this versatile cutter.
Key Features
 5 interchangeable blades for multiple functions
 Food-grade stainless steel and PP plastic design
 Safe spring guard protects fingers while cutting
 Compact, lightweight, and easy to store
 Quick prep for fruits and vegetables
 Easy to clean and reuse daily
Ingredients / Materials
304 stainless steel blades, durable PP plastic
How to Use
 Select the desired blade and attach securely
 Place vegetables or fruits onto the cutter surface
 Use the spring guard to press and glide safely
 Clean with warm water after each use
Package Includes
 1 × Multifunctional 5-Blade Vegetable Cutter & Grater (Random Color)
